# Access Credit Union Limited — Digital Maturity Trajectory

**1 assessment on file** (first 2026-07-02, latest 2026-07-02).


_This summary was auto-generated from the deterministic rollup because the LLM call did not pass validation. An analyst will regenerate it on the next nightly recompute._

narrative.benchmark_md: Peer set of 5 institutions locked in research Phase 0 (DMA-RES-ACCU-MB-20260504-0001). This set spans the digital maturity spectrum — from sector-leading (Meridian) to sector-lagging (Servus) — and includes direct Manitoba competitive peers (Steinbach, Cambrian) and a Salesforce-technology-aligned benchmark (Conexus). All peer scores estimated from public evidence.
narrative.gap_prioritization_md:
The six-factor prioritization formula evaluates each gap across: Gap Size (25%), Peer Comparison (20%), Strategic Alignment to Access CU's 5 strategic objectives (15%), Implementation Complexity inverted (15%), Business Impact (15%), and Stakeholder Readiness (10%). Scores on each factor are normalized 0.0–1.0.
Formula: Priority = (0.25 × Gap_Size) + (0.20 × Peer_Comparison) + (0.15 × Strategic_Alignment) + (0.15 × Implementation_Complexity_inverted) + (0.15 × Business_Impact) + (0.10 × Stakeholder_Readiness)
narrative.scqa_md:
Access Credit Union Limited is a $14.1B in assets credit union regulated by Deposit Guarantee Corporation of Manitoba (DGCM), operating since 2009 with 925 employees. A 9.4% multi-year growth rate and a trajectory the analyst classifies as accelerating give it the balance sheet to fund transformation [E-007, E-001]. Zennify's assessment places overall digital maturity at 1.6/5. The deepest capability gap is MDM Strategy & Golden Record at 1.0/5 against a 1.5 peer median [E-008, E-013]. Next is Operational Data Synchronization (CDC-to-Serving) Architecture at 1.0/5 against a 1.5 peer median [E-017, E-019].

Third is Recommendations & Decisioning at 1.0/5 against a 1.5 peer median [E-024, E-025]. The issue register adds App quality below member expectations — NerdWallet CON for crashes + e-transfer failures; Surviscor not in top-7 CU digi (high severity). The issue register adds Celero June 8 2022 supply-chain cyber incident — unauthorized access to Celero systems. Access was a Celero client. Reso (high severity).

Counter-signal: Reporting Calendar already runs at 2.7/5 against a 2.5 peer median — a strength to build on, not rebuild. The question for Access Credit Union Limited is whether to close MDM Strategy & Golden Record first — the constraint the other investments inherit — or continue layering point solutions on top of it and accept the compounding operating cost. Access Credit Union Limited should lead with nCino (79/100 fit) against Loyalty Program Design, then sequence Tableau behind it. Closing MDM Strategy & Golden Record to the peer median alone is worth 0.5 maturity points, and the capabilities that depend on it compound the gain.
